governingStatute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Act No. 12 of 2017)
title: Composition levy and ineligible tax invoice restrictions
plainTextSummary: A registered person whose aggregate turnover in the preceding financial year did not exceed ₹1.5 Crore (₹75 Lakhs for Special Category States) may opt to pay an amount in lieu of tax under the composition scheme. A composition taxpayer is strictly prohibited from collecting any tax from the recipient and cannot issue a tax invoice (must issue a Bill of Supply). Consequently, a recipient purchasing from a composition supplier is legally prohibited from claiming any Input Tax Credit (ITC) under Section 16(2) and Section 10(4). Any tax erroneously charged by a composition dealer is uncollectible and blocked.

keyStatutoryThresholds.taxCollectionProhibition: Strictly prohibited from collecting tax from recipient u/s 10(4)
keyStatutoryThresholds.itcEligibility: Zero ITC available to recipient purchasing from composition supplier
keyStatutoryThresholds.mandatoryInvoiceHeader: COMPOSITION TAXABLE PERSON, NOT ELIGIBLE TO COLLECT TAX ON SUPPLIES
